drhp.business: ARCL Organics operates in the formaldehyde derivatives and thermosetting-resins value chain, producing formaldehyde, phenolic resins, amino resins, melamine resins, hardeners, specialised one-shot resins and customer-specific chemical solutions. Its products serve plywood and wood panels, laminates, furniture and adhesives, textiles, paper and other process industries.
drhp.end_markets: Plywood and wood panels|Laminates|Furniture and adhesives|Textiles|Paper and other process industries|Domestic and selected export markets
drhp.expansion: During FY2025-26, ARCL strengthened its manufacturing footprint through the acquisition of the existing running unit of Vishvam Formalin and Angel Resins at Kadadra, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, adding 49,500 TPA of Formaldehyde and around 60,000 TPA of Resins. This unit already holds environment clearance for Paraformaldehyde and Hexamine as well, which management expects will eventually help double the Company's existing turnover.

litigation.note: Pending litigation in the matter of Direct & Indirect taxes and other taxes incidental to business and operations, per the Secretarial Audit Report (Annexure B); separately, during the year the Company settled a long-pending customs dues dispute from pre-amalgamation entity Allied Resins & Chemicals Ltd, legacy income tax arrears from the 1988-1998 block period under Vivad Se Vishwas 2.0, and municipal tax dues after withdrawing litigation at Calcutta High Court (Chairman's Message).

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Demand in the Company's addressable markets is linked to housing and renovation activity, infrastructure development, furniture consumption, growth of organised panel and laminate producers, industrial output and customers' preference for consistent quality and reliable technical support.
- Industry is characterised by a mix of organised and unorganised participants, price competition in standard products and a growing premium for customised formulations, process efficiency, low-emission performance and regulatory compliance.
- Margin performance remains sensitive to methanol and other input costs, industry capacity utilisation, freight and the speed at which price movements can be passed through.
- Business outlook remains cautiously positive: India's manufacturing and building-material ecosystems provide a supportive demand base, while increasing formalisation and customer focus on quality create opportunities for organised producers; pace of growth and margin improvement will depend on feedstock spreads, industry capacity utilisation, customer demand, logistics and the Company's ability to convert capital investment into sustainable cash generation.
- Transition towards lower-emission resins, safer handling, improved bonding performance, faster press cycles and resource-efficient manufacturing is creating opportunities for application-led innovation.
- Rising preference for organised suppliers, consistent quality, traceability and dependable technical service creates scope for market-share gains; import substitution and selective export expansion can diversify the customer base and improve the scale of value-added products.

This unit already holds environment clearance for Paraformaldehyde and Hexamine as well, which management expects will eventually help double the Company's existing turnover.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening fundamentals, serving customers with consistency and building capabilities for sustainable growth.
- Pursuing growth with a focus on sustainable returns rather than volume alone; pricing discipline, product mix, asset productivity, working-capital efficiency and risk-adjusted capital allocation to remain central to value creation.
- Developing new business verticals with in-depth R&D, seed marketing and new applications: Feed Additives, RTU (Ready to Use Glue), Laminate Resins, Rubber and Tyre Chemicals, and Resins for Paper Packaging and Corrugated Boxes.
- Managing raw-material price exposure through supplier diversification, procurement planning, inventory discipline, continuous market intelligence, customer engagement and calibrated price revisions.
- Improving utilisation and operating stability across the manufacturing network, scaling value-added and customised resin systems with disciplined customer qualification, strengthening procurement resilience for methanol and other critical inputs, maintaining strict control over receivables/inventories/cash conversion, optimising the balance between growth investment/leverage/debt-service capacity, deepening quality/process safety/environmental compliance/preventive maintenance, and expanding the customer base across domestic and selected export markets.
